# Pre-check Fase 2 - Proxmox DNS - 2026-08-05
# Comandos somente de leitura executados pelo usuario.

hostname: proxmox-dns

root@proxmox-dns[~]# cat /etc/network/interfaces
# network interface settings; autogenerated
source /etc/network/interfaces.d/*

auto lo
iface lo inet loopback

auto enp4s0f1
iface enp4s0f1 inet manual

iface enp3s0f0 inet manual
iface enp3s0f1 inet manual
iface enp4s0f0 inet manual

auto vmbr0
iface vmbr0 inet static
        address 192.168.115.138/30
        gateway 192.168.115.137
        bridge-ports enp3s0f0 enp3s0f1
        bridge-stp off
        bridge-fd 0

# Achado: vmbr0 possui duas portas fisicas sem bond. A topologia documentada
# anteriormente indicava somente um cabo do Proxmox DNS ao RB3011 ether8.
# Confirmar link, MAC e caminho de ambas antes de ativar vlan-aware.

root@proxmox-dns[~]# ip -br link show
lo               UNKNOWN        00:00:00:00:00:00
enp3s0f0         UP             3c:4a:92:ea:ec:0c LOWER_UP
enp3s0f1         DOWN           3c:4a:92:ea:ec:0e NO-CARRIER
enp4s0f0         DOWN           3c:4a:92:ea:ec:04
enp4s0f1         DOWN           3c:4a:92:ea:ec:06 NO-CARRIER
vmbr0            UP             3c:4a:92:ea:ec:0c LOWER_UP
tap101i0         UNKNOWN        ce:ef:7e:0f:31:b2 LOWER_UP
tap102i0         UNKNOWN        b2:f3:8e:71:3e:2c LOWER_UP
tap103i0         UNKNOWN        ce:90:4b:22:77:f4 LOWER_UP
tap105i0         UNKNOWN        be:65:3d:8f:f3:a3 LOWER_UP

# Conclusao: somente enp3s0f0 esta fisicamente conectada. enp3s0f1 consta em
# bridge-ports, mas esta NO-CARRIER. Nao existe loop ativo; usar enp3s0f0 como
# unico enlace da Fase 2 e nao conectar enp3s0f1 sem redesenho/bond explicito.

root@proxmox-dns[~]# qm list
